name: Asato Ma Sadgamaya
text:
असतो मा सद्गमय ।
तमसो मा ज्योतिर्गमय ।
मृत्योर्मा अमृतं गमय ॥
meaning: Lead me from untruth to truth, from darkness to light, and from death to immortality.
purpose: One of the oldest prayers for guidance.
supports: Clarity; hope; moving through a dark time.
when: At the opening of any practice.
